title: Oven Roasted Greek Lamb Kleftiko
description: A savory and tender Greek dish featuring lamb, cucumber, and traditional spices, perfect for a brunch mood. This Whole30-friendly recipe is made in a papillote for easy cleanup.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a small bowl, mix together lemon juice, olive oil, garlic, oregano, salt, and pepper.
Place the lamb shoulder in a large piece of parchment paper or aluminum foil.
Brush the lamb with the lemon juice mixture, making sure to coat it evenly.
Add the sliced cucumber to the parchment paper or foil, placing it on top of the lamb.
Fold the parchment paper or foil over the lamb, creating a tight seal.
Place the lamb in a roasting pan and roast for 3 hours.
Remove the lamb from the oven and let it rest for 10 minutes before slicing.
Slice the lamb and serve with the roasted cucumber and juices.
Garnish with fresh parsley or oregano, if desired.
